name: Code
description: Source code display with optional line numbers and highlighting

language.description: Language hint (used as a data attribute for syntax highlighter integration).

tokenizedLines.description: Pre-tokenized lines from a syntax highlighter (e.g. Shiki). When provided, renders colored tokens instead of plain text. Each entry is an array of tokens for that line.

title.description: Title shown in the header bar.

defaultCollapsed.description: Start collapsed (auto-disables if content is short).

props.title: Files / Playground
long-snippet.ts

notes: Code is an approved mono-content exception and intentionally uses mono typography tokens.
Title and action labels route through Text/Button; tokenizedLines may carry syntax-highlighter colors as source-code data.
Code backgrounds still reference primitive black alpha variables and collapsedHeight uses a numeric compatibility prop; migrate only with visual regression coverage.
